services.name: White-label digital marketing services
services.summary: White-label digital marketing is a wholesale arrangement: a specialist partner delivers campaigns for your clients, and you resell the work as your own. Your client pays you, you pay the partner a wholesale rate, and you keep the margin. Factor42 handles the execution layer: trafficking, QA, optimization and reporting across every major ad platform. Your team keeps the strategy, the pricing and the client relationship. Every report and dashboard carries your logo, and your clients never deal with us directly.

services.name: White-label PPC
services.summary: White-label PPC (pay-per-click) means a specialist team runs your clients' paid search and paid social campaigns while everything the client sees — dashboards, reports, emails — is branded as your agency. You sell the service at your price, pay a wholesale fulfillment rate, and keep the difference. It's the fastest way to say yes to more PPC clients without hiring, training and licensing tools for an in-house team. Factor42 handles campaign builds, bidding, negative keywords, audience layering, creative rotation, pacing and reporting; you stay the face of the account.

services.name: White-label Google Ads
services.summary: Your agency sells Google Ads management to the client. Factor42 does the hands-on work inside the client's Google Ads account, which you own and grant us access to: account structure, keyword research, campaign builds, bidding, negative keywords and ongoing optimization. Reporting goes out with your branding, through Google Analytics 4 and Campaign Manager 360 where you use them. Your account managers present the results; we keep the account tuned between meetings.

services.name: White-label Facebook & Instagram ads
services.summary: White-label Facebook ads management means a specialist team builds and optimizes your clients' Meta campaigns inside the Business Manager accounts you control, and every report carries your agency's brand. You set the price; we do the work. Paid social changes fast — formats, placements, audiences and creative fatigue all move week to week. A dedicated team keeps campaigns current, so your account managers can focus on the client instead of the ads manager.

services.name: White-label programmatic, CTV & DOOH
services.summary: White-label programmatic means a partner plans, traffics and optimizes your clients' programmatic buys — display, video, audio, streaming TV and digital out-of-home — while your agency or station sells and reports them as its own. Most agencies don't have seats on several DSPs or the specialists to run them. Factor42 operates across DV360, The Trade Desk, Xandr, Amazon DSP and the major DOOH exchanges, with brand-safety and viewability controls on every buy.

services.name: Outsourced ad operations & trafficking
services.summary: Ad operations is the work between a signed order and a live, delivering campaign: trafficking, creative QA, tracking, pacing, troubleshooting, reconciliation and reporting. Outsourcing it means a dedicated team takes that work off your sellers and account managers. Factor42 works as an extension of your team, inside your platforms and under your brand. Orders come in through one brief format; campaigns go live, get watched daily and close with a wrap report in your name.
